create_CLIP_VITS16: create a CLIP model with ViT-small MoCoV3 encoder and 512-dim embeddings
build_SLIP_VITB16: build a SLIP model combining CLIP and SimCLR with ViT-base encoder
test_SIMCLR_VITL16: test a SimCLR self-supervised model with ViT-large encoder for contrastive learning
run_get_loss: run get_loss to retrieve the appropriate loss function for CLIP, SLIP, or SimCLR models
summarize_get_metric_names: summarize get_metric_names to return training metric names based on model type
